links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy for PH of AI-derived versus manual TRJV measurements on same echocardiograms
links.effect: AUC 0.88 (95% CI 0.84-0.90) for automated versus 0.88 (95% CI 0.86-0.91) for manual; noninferior. ICC 0.94 (95% CI 0.94-0.95); TRJV measured in 87% of echocardiograms.
links.quote: Automated TRJV measurements showed equally high diagnostic accuracy for PH as manual measurements (area under the curve 0.88, 95% CI 0.84-0.90 versus 0.88, 95% CI 0.86-0.91).

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation evaluating the diagnostic accuracy of an automated echocardiography interpretation tool (US2.AI) compared to manual measurements, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
